input.prompt: A simple stylized low-poly one-handed starter sword for a cartoony academy dungeon adventure. Chunky readable proportions matching stylized teenage adventurer characters. Clean flat color blocking, restrained metal highlights, minimal decoration, no gems, no runes, no glow, no damage, no scabbard, no character, no stand.
